description: What has happened for a company since a date, read against its case: the latest quarter's earnings, filings and 8-K events, insider trades, capital returns, price move. Use when the user asks: what changed with X; catch me up on X. response_mode=plain for beginners. Not for: the standing case → get_thesis. Args: entity; since.

entity.description: The company: a ticker (AAPL, BRK.B), a company name (Apple) or an SEC CIK.
entity.title: Entity

reading_level.description: With response_mode plain, who the explanation is written for: 5 a complete beginner, 10 a general reader, 13 an informed investor (unset reads as 13, with precise figures).
reading_level.title: Reading Level

response_mode.description: "standard" (default): the full read with the investment case; "plain": a short beginner-friendly explanation at the reading_level grade.
response_mode.title: Response Mode

since.description: Window start as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); unset reads the last 30 days.
since.title: Since

name: what_changed
title: What changed recently
